families.name: Qwen

Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B.engines: HF Native Memory; portable Selected Context
Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B.recommended_mode: Selected Context; qualify Native Memory locally

mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-4bit.engines: MLX routing qualification; portable Selected Context
mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-4bit.recommended_mode: Generic balanced; learned router only for matched QASPER

mlx-community/Qwen3-14B-4bit.engines: MLX routing qualification; portable Selected Context
mlx-community/Qwen3-14B-4bit.recommended_mode: Generic balanced; learned router only for matched QASPER

families.adapter_detail: The SDK includes Qwen2/Qwen3 structural mappings. Export a declarative adapter when the deployment needs a pinned, reviewable artifact.
families.evidence: Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B have five-seed, held-out MLX routing comparisons. Learned routing improves QASPER but regresses on HotpotQA, so generic routing remains the portable default.
commands: pra serve Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B --engine hf --mode auto --profile recommended
limitations: Model revision, tokenizer, quantization, engine, and profile still require qualification together.

families.name: Llama

mlx-community/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-4bit.engines: MLX routing qualification; portable Selected Context
mlx-community/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-4bit.recommended_mode: Generic balanced; learned router only for matched QASPER

families.adapter_detail: The SDK includes the conventional Llama decoder mapping. A declarative adapter is optional for discovery and recommended for pinned releases.
families.evidence: Llama-3.1-8B has a five-seed, held-out MLX routing comparison. Learned routing improves QASPER MRR but reduces HotpotQA recall, so generic routing remains the default.
commands: pra serve unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B --engine hf --mode auto --profile recommended
limitations: Instruction tuning and quantized derivatives are separate qualification identities.

families.name: Gemma 3 text

mlx-community/gemma-3-1b-it-4bit.engines: MLX mixed/sliding routing qualification; portable Selected Context
mlx-community/gemma-3-1b-it-4bit.recommended_mode: Generic balanced; learned router for matched QASPER or validated mixed workloads

families.adapter_detail: A built-in mapping discovers Gemma 3 text attention, but its heterogeneous topology must be exported, reviewed, and validated for the exact revision before Native Memory is promoted.
families.evidence: Gemma-3-1B has a five-seed, held-out MLX comparison under its mixed sliding/global topology. Learned routing helps QASPER and combined MRR, while HotpotQA recall remains mixed.
limitations: Sliding/global attention topology and multimodal wrappers require explicit review.

families.name: Other Hugging Face causal decoders
families.adapter_detail: Selected Context needs no attention adapter. Native Memory requires a generated declarative mapping or reviewed Python plugin plus the complete validation ladder.
families.evidence: No family-wide native claim is made for unregistered architectures.
limitations: Projection-name discovery alone does not establish mask, position, cache, or generation correctness.

families.name: Models behind ordinary API endpoints
examples: vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, llama.cpp, OpenVINO or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
families.adapter_detail: The gateway can select and render context for an ordinary endpoint without modifying the model. Native modes require an explicit backend capability handshake and model qualification.
families.evidence: Selected Context is the portable cross-engine path.
commands: pra gateway serve --mode selected-context --backend custom --backend-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1
limitations: Do not infer detached Native Memory from prefix caching or a paged K/V implementation.
